sample_unit: clinical trial protocols (key information sections of informed consent forms)

links.outcome: Readability and understandability of LLM-generated consent form key information versus human-written
links.effect: LLM RUAKI readability 76.39% vs 66.67%; Flesch-Kincaid grade level 7.95 vs 8.38; understandability 90.63% vs 67.19% (P=.02); actionability 100% vs 0% (P<.001).
links.quote: The LLM outperformed human-generated ICFs in readability (Readability, Understandability, and Actionability of Key Information score of 76.39% vs 66.67%; Flesch-Kincaid grade level of 7.95 vs 8.38) and understandability (90.63% vs 67.19%; P=.02).

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to draft plain-language informed consent form key information sections from clinical trial protocols

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM (Mistral 8x22B) for drafting clinical trial informed consent forms compared to human drafting, assessed by multidisciplinary expert evaluators offline.
